posts.meta_description:
693 likes, 21 comments - namratapurohit on September 25, 2026: "Tried something new and it was 🔥 It required a lot of control from the core and the lower back had to really stabilise and fire right! Also the shoulders.. wow! Always fun trying new exercises, even after all these years.. and I’m always the first to experiment on myself enough times before I think of teaching it to someone else. Sometimes an idea comes to my head, sometimes I see something that gives me an idea, but without understanding the “why” behind the exercise, the “what” like what’s working, what can go wrong, I’d never teach the exercise. So first I do it myself many times… 

PS: someone was super close to the reformer for safety but didn’t want to be in frame 

#pilates #pilatesinstructor #fitnessmotivation #trainsmart #fitnessinstructor".
